en_title: Don't Play Halo: Campaign Evolved on Steam Deck or Xbox Ally
cn_title: 《光环：战役进化》在Steam Deck和XBOX Ally上还不如老版
subtitle: 掌机玩家应选《士官长合集》

paragraphs.en: Halo: Campaign Evolved is basically already here if you pay the early access tax, and while it does look incredible on high-end gaming PCs and current-generation consoles, it struggles hard on lower-end hardware, particularly handheld gaming PCs. I spent a little bit of time playing the remake on the Xbox Ally, and, well, the original Halo campaign looks a whole lot better in the Master Chief Collection .
paragraphs.cn: 只要愿意为抢先体验多花钱，《光环：战役进化》现在基本已经可以玩到。它在高端游戏PC和本世代主机上的确非常惊艳，却在低端硬件上表现吃力，掌机尤其如此。我在XBOX Ally上试玩了一会儿这款重制版，结果发现《光环：士官长合集》里的初代战役看起来要好得多。

paragraphs.en: It shouldn't be too surprising that Campaign Evolved doesn't run super well on low-end handhelds like the Steam Deck . The game calls for a minimum of an Intel Core i7-10700K and an Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060 Super , both of which are more powerful than the equivalents found in the base Xbox Ally and the Steam Deck. But, for some reason, the Steam page for the game says the game is Steam Deck Verified.
paragraphs.cn: 《光环：战役进化》在Steam Deck等低端掌机上运行不佳，其实并不令人意外。游戏最低配置要求Intel Core i7-10700K和Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060 Super，两者都比基础款XBOX Ally与Steam Deck中的对应硬件更强。但不知为何，游戏的Steam页面却标注其已通过Steam Deck验证。

paragraphs.en: In order to run the game on the Xbox Ally, I set the resolution to 1280x720 and set it to the Very Low preset, with FSR set to Low. With those settings, I'm getting a pretty playable 30 fps, with occasional dips down to the mid 20s. That's probably why the game skated by with a Steam Deck Verified label, I've seen games perform worse and still get that green checkmark.
paragraphs.cn: 为了让游戏在XBOX Ally上运行，我把分辨率设为1280×720，画质调至「极低」预设，并将FSR设为「低」。在这些设置下，游戏基本能以可玩的30帧运行，偶尔会跌至20多帧的中段。这大概就是它能勉强拿到Steam Deck验证标签的原因，毕竟我也见过表现更差的游戏照样得到绿色认证标记。

paragraphs.en: But while the game is playable at these settings, it's genuinely an eyesore. In order to keep the framerate up, visual fidelity is low, textures are entirely bland, and vegetation and other environmental objects are virtually nonexistent. Plus, the upscaling at this resolution makes the game look like a blurry, staticky mess on top of all of that loss of detail.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，游戏虽然能在这些设置下运行，画面却实在不堪入目。为了维持帧率，视觉精度被压得很低，纹理毫无质感，植被和其他环境物件也几乎消失。更糟的是，在这一分辨率下进行画面放大，让本就损失大量细节的画面变得模糊不清，还布满噪点。

paragraphs.en: And while there are some elements of the game that still look alright, namely walls and other objects having a bit more detail to them, Halo just looks better in the Master Chief Collection, even if it looks like an older game (which it is). Just looking at these screenshots from the second mission when you're fighting off a bunch of Covenant reinforcements, the Campaign Evolved screenshot has a virtually flat environment, with a blurry Elite being shot at. In the Master Chief Collection, the wall on the right doesn't look quite as good, but there's actually vegetation on the ground, and the enemy being shot at doesn't look like as much of a blurry mess.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏里仍有一些元素看起来还算不错，例如墙壁和部分物件拥有更多细节，但《光环》在《士官长合集》中的整体观感依然更好，即使它明显是一款老游戏——事实上也确实如此。以第二个任务中抵御一批星盟增援的截图为例，《战役进化》的环境几乎一片平坦，被射击的精英战士也十分模糊。《士官长合集》右侧的墙面虽然没有那么精细，地面上却真正存在植被，遭到射击的敌人也没有糊成一团。

paragraphs.en: What makes this even more wild is the performance on offer. With these settings, the Master Chief Collection is getting a solid 65-70 fps most of the time on the Xbox Ally, compared to 25-30 fps in Campaign Evolved. And keep in mind that the Xbox Ally and the Steam Deck have extremely comparable performance.
paragraphs.cn: 更夸张的是两者的性能差距。在相同设备上，《士官长合集》大部分时间都能在XBOX Ally上稳定达到65至70帧，而《战役进化》只有25至30帧。别忘了，XBOX Ally与Steam Deck的性能非常接近。

paragraphs.en: I love the original Halo – there was a good decade where the only reason I kept a console in my house was to play Halo games. So while I will absolutely be playing this new remake on a high-end PC or even a more powerful handheld like the MSI Claw 8 EX AI+ , if you want to play this original campaign on the Steam Deck, just download the Master Chief Collection instead.
paragraphs.cn: 我非常喜欢初代《光环》——曾经有整整十年，我家里保留主机的唯一理由就是玩《光环》。所以我肯定会在高端PC，甚至MSI Claw 8 AI+这样的更强掌机上游玩这款新重制版；但如果你想在Steam Deck上体验初代战役，直接下载《光环：士官长合集》就好。

summary: 《光环：战役进化》在XBOX Ally与Steam Deck级别硬件上只能以极低画质维持约25至30帧，画面模糊且环境细节严重缩水。相比之下，《光环：士官长合集》在XBOX Ally上可达65至70帧，掌机玩家更适合选择老版本。
opus_summary: 新重制版在高端设备上很惊艳，但到了XBOX Ally和Steam Deck级别的掌机上，极低画质仍只有25至30帧；老版《士官长合集》不仅更清晰，还能跑到65至70帧。
